def factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_accel(df):
    """Volatility asymmetry of intraday returns amplified by volume acceleration."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["open"] - 1.0
    up_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(lower=0), 2)
    down_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(upper=0), 2)
    asym = up_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean() - down_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_short = df_copy["volume"].rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_medium = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_accel = vol_short / vol_medium.replace(0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_accel"] = asym * vol_accel
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_vol_accel"]
description: Volatility asymmetry captures the difference between upside and downside intraday volatility (squared returns), indicating whether recent intraday moves have been predominantly upward or downward. Volume acceleration (ratio of short-term to medium-term average volume) signals a shift in volume regime, amplifying the asymmetry signal when volume is surging, which suggests conviction behind the direction. This aims to capture directional pressure with a non-linear volume component to improve MI.
